game_source.game_patch: Contains verified patch 188329 balance changes; exact executable build not embedded in DAT

assumptions.age: Post-Imperial, all available upgrades; research priced in Imperial
assumptions.farm_scenario: 10 workers; 1800 game-seconds; 3 seeds; reseeding; generic 2x2 mill or 3x3 Folwark with 8 covered and 2 outer farms
assumptions.wood_scenario: 10 workers; 8x6 forest, fixed camp; measured seconds 60–600; 3 seeds
assumptions.mining_scenario: 10 workers; four mineral tiles and camp one tile away; measured seconds 60–240; 3 seeds
assumptions.labor: sum(resource cost / effective resource rate) + food cost * farm wood per food / wood rate; construction during reseeding is included in farm simulation
assumptions.attrition: Actual dead-unit counts, not remaining HP, determine replacement costs. Loser is an attrition candidate only if its replacement labor is lower.
assumptions.production: One selected cheapest production building per side; selected by wood + 2*stone. Alternative routes retained; queue time ignores affordability and transit.
assumptions.upgrades: Common tech IDs only for time and common cost; exclusive packages and distinct research buildings separate. Sums are research workload, not elapsed build order.
assumptions.robustness: Candidate must survive opposing ±5% rate perturbations; this is a sensitivity assumption, not a statistical confidence bound or game validation.
assumptions.scope: Village labor only; no allied team bonuses, relics, trade, market exchanges or aura coverage. Unresolved coupled income/refund mechanics flagged; no fabricated rates.
assumptions.outcome: No combat result is changed. Economic candidates require a repeated-battle/position scenario before claiming a military reversal.
assumptions.source_warning: Saved battle campaign mixes engine versions; equivalent combat profiles are expanded using each civilization's own economic inputs.
